## mcrl downtime create

Create a downtime.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl downtime create --name <name> --duration <duration> [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a downtime. Without a scope flag the downtime applies to every monitor.

--start accepts the same expressions as --since elsewhere (default: now).

API: POST /api/v0/downtimes
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  # Silence the web service for the next 2 hours
  mcrl downtime create --name "emergency maintenance" --duration 2h --service web

  # Every Monday and Thursday 02:00-03:00 until the end of the year
  mcrl downtime create --name backup --start "2026-11-09 02:00" --duration 1h --recurrence weekly:mon,thu --until 2026-12-31

Flags:
      --duration string               length, e.g. "2h", "90m", "1d"
      --exclude-monitor stringArray   excluded monitor (repeatable)
      --exclude-role stringArray      excluded role (repeatable)
      --exclude-service stringArray   excluded service (repeatable)
  -f, --file string                   JSON or YAML file in the API's format ("-" for stdin); flags override its fields
      --interval int                  repeat every N hours/days/weeks/... (with --recurrence) (default 1)
      --memo string                   memo
      --monitor stringArray           target monitor, ID or name (repeatable)
      --name string                   name
      --recurrence string             repeat: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly; weekly takes days, e.g. "weekly:mon,thu"
      --role stringArray              target role as <service>:<role> (repeatable)
      --service stringArray           target service (repeatable)
      --start string                  start time (default "now" on create)
      --until string                  end of the recurrence (with --recurrence)
```

## mcrl downtime delete

Delete a downtime.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl downtime delete <downtime>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a downtime. The output is the downtime as it was before deletion.

API: DELETE /api/v0/downtimes/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl downtime delete backup
  mcrl downtime delete 3Ja1bAxcdef --yes
```

## mcrl downtime edit

Edit a downtime in $EDITOR.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl downtime edit <downtime>

Open the current downtime as YAML in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (default vi), then
show the changes and send them after confirmation.

The whole object is sent back, including fields mcrl does not know about,
so nothing is lost. Read-only fields (id) are hidden. If the file does not
parse, the editor opens again with the error at the top. Saving an empty file
or leaving it unchanged cancels.

API: PUT /api/v0/downtimes/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl downtime edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
  EDITOR='code --wait' mcrl downtime edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl downtime get

Show a downtime.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl downtime get <downtime>

Aliases:
  get, show

Show a downtime by ID or name.

A reference that looks like an ID (11 alphanumeric characters) is looked up
as an ID first. Prefix it with "id:" or "name:" to force either.

API: GET /api/v0/downtimes
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl downtime get weekly-maintenance
  mcrl downtime get 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl downtime list

List downtimes.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl downtime list [flags]

Aliases:
  list, ls

List downtimes.

--active keeps only the downtimes in effect now. Recurring downtimes are
evaluated in the local time zone.

API: GET /api/v0/downtimes
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl downtime list
  mcrl downtime list --active --jq '.[].name'

Flags:
      --active   only downtimes in effect now
```

## mcrl downtime update

Update a downtime.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl downtime update <downtime> [flags]

Update a downtime. The current downtime is fetched and the given flags
(and -f fields) are changed; everything else is kept.

API: GET /api/v0/downtimes, PUT /api/v0/downtimes/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl downtime update backup --duration 90m
  mcrl downtime update 3Ja1bAxcdef --service web --service batch

Flags:
      --duration string               length, e.g. "2h", "90m", "1d"
      --exclude-monitor stringArray   excluded monitor (repeatable)
      --exclude-role stringArray      excluded role (repeatable)
      --exclude-service stringArray   excluded service (repeatable)
  -f, --file string                   JSON or YAML file in the API's format ("-" for stdin); flags override its fields
      --interval int                  repeat every N hours/days/weeks/... (with --recurrence) (default 1)
      --memo string                   memo
      --monitor stringArray           target monitor, ID or name (repeatable)
      --name string                   name
      --recurrence string             repeat: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly; weekly takes days, e.g. "weekly:mon,thu"
      --role stringArray              target role as <service>:<role> (repeatable)
      --service stringArray           target service (repeatable)
      --start string                  start time (default "now" on create)
      --until string                  end of the recurrence (with --recurrence)
```
